defs.def: trust in sb's ability or knowledge; trust that sb/sth will do what has been promised 信任；相信；信心

ex.s: I talked to one of the senior applicants who answered questions in a way that reflected the faith she had in herself.
ex.t: 我和一位高年级申请者交谈，她回答问题时展现出对自己的信心。

ex.s: My faith in human nature has never been so great as it was last weekend after our family get-together in the town of Vail.
ex.t: 我对人性的信心从未像上周末在韦尔镇家庭聚会后那样强烈。

ex.s: “I think the faith that everyone has shown    33    him has touched him.
ex.t: “我认为，每个人表现出来的信念，有33人触摸过他。

ex.s: They reflect people’s wishes, beliefs, faiths, and attitudes towards life.
ex.t: 它们反映了人们的愿望、信仰、信心和对待生活的态度。

ex.s: Festivals people’s wishes, beliefs, faiths, and attitudes towards life.
ex.t: 节日 人们的愿望、信仰、信心和对待生活的态度。

ex.s: Our optimism and faith in Shackleton had helped us persevere in staying alive.
ex.t: 我们对沙克尔顿的乐观和信念帮助我们坚持活了下来。

ex.s: He had great faith in the talent of the up-and-coming generation.
ex.t: 他对崭露头角的新一代的才华充满了信心。

defs.def: strong religious belief 宗教信仰；信德

ex.s: She remains true to herself and never loses hope, faith or dignity in her search for love and happiness.
ex.t: 她始终保持真实，在追寻爱与幸福的过程中从未失去希望、信念或尊严。

defs.def: the intention to do sth right 诚意；善意
